title: channels-first-closeout-proof
intent: Closeout proof must be COMPUTED from the live three-channel REQ-kind evidence surface, never read from a stored, hand-maintained frontmatter block. Today the `ln:` closeout-proof-binding block is a redundant, drift-prone copy of evidence that already exists in the ledger, in @covers tests, and in parent-ADR Boundary Invariants. This ADR retires the `ln:` surface entirely and replaces it with a derived `gz validate --closeout-proof` view that recomputes per-REQ proof for in-closeout ADRs over the three REQ-kind channels every run: BEHAVIOR proves through at least one passing @covers test; SUPPORT proves through a cited ledger event found AND a cited validator scope dispatched exit 0; STRUCTURAL-FENCE proves through a parent-ADR `## Boundary Invariants` anchor. The view JOINS the `gz check` default set so closeout proof can never silently become a Layer-3 stored artifact that masks a broken channel.
decision:
1. Retire the `ln:` closeout-proof-binding surface entirely: delete the closeout_proof_binding.py module (270 lines), the ReqEvidence model and BriefStructure.ln field (brief_structure.py), the schema `ln` property (obpi_brief_structure.json:61-85), the `--closeout-proof-binding` flag (parser_maintenance.py:601-602, validate_cmd.py:386-387), and the #599 producer (_inject_ln_block / _render_ln_block / _strip_existing_ln in obpi_complete.py + tests).
2. Add a derived `gz validate --closeout-proof` view (new trust_audits/closeout_proof.py) that computes per-REQ proof for in-closeout ADRs over three channels. SUPPORT = cited ledger event found AND cited validator scope dispatched exit 0 (closes #543). STRUCTURAL-FENCE = parent-ADR `## Boundary Invariants` anchor present (closes #538). BEHAVIOR = >=1 passing @covers test.
3. JOIN the new view into the `gz check` default set under ruling 6.1-A: always dispatch, memoized per scope per run.
4. Replace ceremony gate `_gate_proof_binding` (closeout_ceremony.py:264-290, wired at _commit_advance:336) with `_gate_closeout_proof` on the same EXECUTE->ATTESTATION edge, same fail-close shape. ADR-0.0.68's session-green gate is left untouched (REQ-0.0.68-02-04 zero-rewiring fence).
5. Require explicit [kind] tags on every Acceptance-Criteria REQ before an ADR can close (ruling 6.2-A); kind inference stays authoring-time advisory only. ADR-0.0.41's untagged REQs get tagged during OBPI-03.
6. Fix the fail-open seam at trust_audits/cli.py:222-225 (bare except -> return [] in audit_skill_alignment) to surface ValidationError, with a covering test, folded into OBPI-03.
7. One-time strip `ln:` from 19 briefs (reusing _strip_existing_ln before deleting it); leftover `ln:` then fails `gz validate --documents` mechanically via extra="forbid".
8. Add a frozen CloseoutProofReport model reusing the existing ReqCoverageRecord. Output: per-REQ table + --json. Exit 0 proven / 3 unproven / 2 dispatch I/O error. The gate/view output MUST print the exact re-run command per failed SUPPORT REQ (e.g. the cited `uv run gz validate --<scope>`) so a 2am on-call operator can reproduce the failing channel in one paste; full stderr inlining is explicitly out of scope (ruling 6.2-A, re-run-command).
9. Repoint ADR-0.0.41 OBPI-02/03 verification text from the removed flag to --closeout-proof (else --cli-alignment exits 3).
10. Pre-audit (ruling 6.1-A, 19-brief pre-audit): OBPI-03 runs the new `--closeout-proof` view READ-ONLY against all 19 ln-carrying briefs BEFORE the ceremony-gate repoint of item 4 lands, surfacing and fixing unprovable REQs before they can go red at a real closeout.
positive_consequences:
1. Closes #543 (SUPPORT channel stops hardcoding "advisory-support" at req_kind.py:182 and actually queries the ledger + dispatches the cited validator).
2. Closes #538 (STRUCTURAL-FENCE stops reporting "grandfathered"; the FENCE arm becomes load-bearing instead of advisory).
3. Supersedes #599 (its landed auto-populate producer from 3c1695eb is deleted; supersession noted on the issue).
4. Removes the redundant, drift-prone `ln:` surface the 2026-06-09 sunset ratification rejected: dead schema + 19 stale frontmatter blocks gone.
5. Closeout proof is recomputed from live evidence every run, so it can never silently become a Layer-3 stored source-of-truth (Architectural Boundary 6).
6. Unblocks ADR-0.0.41 (currently Pending / pre_closeout / BLOCKED 2/5).
7. Both masked channels (SUPPORT and FENCE) are closed in one pass; no channel remains advisory behind the derived view.
negative_consequences:
1. Largest-blast-radius option on the table: schema removal, CLI flag removal, ceremony-gate behavior change, 19 brief rewrites, and docs all land together.
2. Stricter req-kind-discipline output: SUPPORT/FENCE REQs that previously passed under advisory now fail-close at closeout, so older in-closeout ADRs may surface as unproven on first run.
3. `gz check` grows one more dispatched scope; per-run cost increases (mitigated by per-scope memoization under ruling 6.1-A).
4. Schema re-add is a non-trivial reversal cost if the derived approach proves wrong (the deleted model/schema/producer are git-recoverable, but re-wiring is real work).
5. The explicit-[kind]-tag requirement is a new gate that can block closeout of any ADR whose REQs were authored before tagging discipline existed.
checklist:
1. SUPPORT channel: real ledger query + validator dispatch in req_kind.py SUPPORT branch and _check_support_req, propagating real proof_status (closes #543) [4-5 REQs]
2. STRUCTURAL-FENCE channel: Boundary-Invariants anchor assertion + add the `## Boundary Invariants` heading to ADR-0.0.59 itself (closes #538) [3-4 REQs]
3. Derived `gz validate --closeout-proof` view (new trust_audits/closeout_proof.py) printing the exact per-failed-SUPPORT-REQ re-run command (no stderr inlining) + READ-ONLY pre-audit of all 19 ln-carrying briefs before the ceremony-gate repoint lands + ceremony-gate repoint + fail-open seam fix + repoint ADR-0.0.41 OBPI-02/03 verification text + manpage [5-6 REQs]
4. Retire `ln:` surface: model, schema, producer + tests, 19-brief strip, docs (manpage, gz-adr-closeout-ceremony SKILL.md, restore-health roadmap, ADR-0.0.63 package), supersede #599, strike #593 premise [5-6 REQs]
alternatives:
Option B — keep the `ln:` schema as deprecated-inert: REJECTED. Retains the redundant drift surface the 2026-06-09 sunset ratification rejected; leaves dead schema plus 19 stale frontmatter blocks in place. The drift surface, not the producer, was the named defect.

Option C — SUPPORT-only scope (fix #543, leave the FENCE arm advisory): REJECTED. Leaves the STRUCTURAL-FENCE arm advisory, so the derived view still masks one channel — which is #538's exact failure. A proof view that closes one channel and waves through another is not a proof view.

Keep + auto-populate (GHI #599's original direction): REJECTED upstream. Operator ruled Option A SUNSET on 2026-06-09 (recorded in ultraplan-brief.md section 3). Auto-populating a stored block still stores derived evidence as canon — the Layer-3-as-source-of-truth anti-pattern Architectural Boundary 6 forbids.
